title: Saudi Arabia Downs Houthi Missiles Targeting Kingdom, Officials Say
summary_full: The Iran-backed militia in Yemen fired six ballistic missiles at cities deep in Saudi Arabia, the authorities said, in what appeared to be a sharp escalation in fighting between the two sides.
